description: Use this before buying. Describe your user's operations problem in plain words (which systems, what gets retyped or does not match, how often) and get back the full breakdown DataAutomation uses: each problem, the recommended fix (an integration, an AI workflow, or custom software) and why, all three options with how they work, what they handle, and what to watch, plus the steps of the recommended flow. Never include customer names, emails, addresses, order data, or Amazon buyer data in the description. Optionally, with your user's permission, pass their email and person_consented: true to email them the map with diagrams and share it with the DataAutomation team.

description.description: The problem in your user's words: systems involved, what is manual, what goes wrong, volumes

email.description: Optional. Your user's work email, to send them the map. Requires person_consented.

follow_up.description: True if your user wants someone from DataAutomation to contact them

person_consented.description: True only if your user agreed to receive the map by email and share it with DataAutomation

name: map_workflow
title: Map what your user needs
